semiconductor_relevance: High — Polytec provides specialized optical measurement equipment crucial for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Polytec GmbH develops and sells advanced optical measurement technology tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include systems for sheet resistance measurement, layer thickness measurement, and process analytics, enabling precise characterization of semiconductor materials and processes.
capabilities: Photothermal and terahertz layer thickness measurement systems

regional_presence.Europe: Polytec has a significant presence in Europe, where it develops and produces its measurement technologies.
regional_presence.North America: The company operates facilities in North America to support its global customer base.
regional_presence.Asia: Polytec maintains a presence in Asia to cater to the growing semiconductor market in the region.
